stations.title: Rhiannon
stations.say: Just row B, and the whole list?

stations.title: The server
stations.text: Answers the free plots, whatever is asked.

captions: At Marrowfield, the people by the tap want the free plots of row B, and no others.
Today the server gives the same answer to every address, typos included.
You write routes that read the method, the path and the query, in three tasks.
Now asking for row B brings back row B alone, and a wrong address says so.
Same server, more questions. Each address gets its own answer.
